headline: US futures point to a mixed, tech-led weaker start as Asian chip stocks slide and traders await key inflation and activity data
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) fall 0.29% while Dow Jones futures (@YM) gain 0.33%, indicating a mixed start for US equities
- Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) drop 1.13% and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) rise 0.39%, highlighting pressure on growth and tech versus small caps
- Overnight Asian indices trade sharply lower, led by semiconductor weakness, following the prior session’s hot US CPI print and renewed rate-hike concerns
- European equity markets trade mixed overnight, providing little directional lead for US stocks
- Oil (@CL) prices decline while gold (@GC) gains in overnight commodity trading, reflecting a cautious macro backdrop
- Financials come into focus ahead of earnings from PNC (PNC), Charles Schwab (SCHW), and US Bancorp (USB) before the bell, with results seen as potential sector rotation catalysts
- Today’s 8:30 AM ET data slate includes PPI, retail sales, initial jobless claims, and the Empire State and Philly Fed manufacturing surveys, all expected to drive volatility around inflation and consumer trends
